subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Taciturnity
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Silence**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"taciturnity"** means the quality or state of being reserved or reticent in speech; being inclined to silence. (मौनता)

 
 
• **Example: **His taciturnity made him appear mysterious to many people in the office.
 
 

 
• **"Silence"** refers to the absence of sound or speech, aligning closely with the concept of taciturnity. (मौन)
 
 
• **Example: **The room was filled with an eerie silence after the announcement.
 
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'taciturnity'** is **'silence'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Silence**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Eloquence** (वाकपटुता): Fluent or persuasive speaking or writing.
 
 
• **Example:** The politician's eloquence won the hearts of many voters.
 
 

 
• **Talkative** (बातूनी): Fond of or given to talking a lot.
 
 
• **Example:** She is very talkative and loves to share her stories with everyone.
 
 

 
• **Tactic** (युक्ति): An action or strategy carefully planned to achieve a specific end.
 
 
• **Example:** The manager's tactic to boost sales was highly effective.
